title: Furnace Page
text: Furnace Page carries a ceremonial blade too large for its frame and attacks anyone who will not kneel. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: A ruined title still demands an audience.

defeatReward.text: Furnace Page is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
